chat.meta_desc: The best AI chatbots and assistants compared: which one to use for writing, research, coding help and everyday questions, which have a free plan, and how they differ.
chat.intro: General-purpose AI assistants answer questions, write and edit text, analyze files and help with code. They differ mostly in answer quality on hard tasks, web search, file and image handling, and how generous the free plan is — start with the top three and keep the one that fits your work.

agents.h1: Best AI agents and automation tools
agents.meta_desc: The best AI agents and workflow automation platforms: connect apps, automate routine tasks and build agents that act on your behalf. Free options and key differences.
agents.intro: This category covers two kinds of tools: workflow builders that connect your apps and run steps automatically, and agents that take a goal and work out the steps themselves. Builders are more predictable for repeat tasks; agents save time on one-off research and multi-step jobs.

code.meta_desc: The best AI coding tools: assistants in the editor, autonomous coding agents and app generators. Which one fits your workflow, which are free, and how they compare.
code.intro: AI coding tools range from autocomplete inside your editor to agents that plan changes across a whole repository and run tests on their own. Pick by where you work (IDE, terminal or browser), how much autonomy you want, and whether you need to use your own model keys.

writing.meta_desc: The best AI writing, translation and editing tools: grammar checking, paraphrasing, readability and marketing copy. Free plans and how the tools differ.
writing.intro: Writing tools either improve text you have already written — grammar, style, clarity, translation — or generate new copy from a brief. For most people an editing tool plus a general AI assistant covers more than a dedicated copy generator.

marketing.h1: Best AI marketing and SEO tools
marketing.meta_desc: The best AI tools for SEO and marketing: keyword research, content optimization, ad creatives and copywriting. What each one is best at and how they compare.
marketing.intro: Marketing AI covers keyword and competitor research, content optimization for search, and generation of ad creatives and copy. SEO suites give you the data and content tools turn it into pages — many teams use one of each.

image.meta_desc: The best AI image generators compared: photorealism, text in images, editing and style control. Which one to choose for your task and which can be used for free.
image.intro: Image generators differ in photorealism, how well they render text, how precisely they follow a prompt and how much control you get when editing. Some run in a chat window, others give you a full canvas or run locally on your own computer.

video.meta_desc: The best AI video tools: text-to-video models, AI avatars and smart editors. Which one to use for ads, social clips or explainers, and which have a free plan.
video.intro: AI video tools fall into three groups: models that generate footage from a prompt or image, avatar tools that turn a script into a presenter video, and editors that cut, caption and repurpose what you already have. Decide which of these jobs you need before comparing quality.

design.meta_desc: The best AI design tools for graphics, UI and web design, logos, product photos and background removal. Which one fits your task and which are free to start.
design.intro: Design AI ranges from all-in-one editors for social graphics to tools that turn a prompt into a UI layout, a website or a logo. Choose by the output you need and whether you must hand off editable files to a designer or developer.

voice.h1: Best AI voice and audio tools
voice.meta_desc: The best AI tools for voiceover, text-to-speech, transcription, music and podcast editing. What each one is best at and which you can use for free.
voice.intro: Audio AI covers voice generation and cloning, speech-to-text, music creation and cleanup of recorded speech. Most tools specialise in one of these, so pick the task first, then compare voice quality, languages and the license for commercial use.

productivity.meta_desc: The best AI productivity tools: meeting notes and transcription, smart calendars, notes and automation. Which one saves the most time and which are free.
productivity.intro: Productivity AI takes over routine work around meetings, notes and scheduling: it records and summarizes calls, plans your calendar and connects the apps you already use. The best choice depends on where your team works — video calls, docs or task lists.

research.meta_desc: The best AI tools for research: search and summarize scientific papers, check claims against sources and chat with your own documents. Free options compared.
research.intro: Research AI helps you find relevant papers, extract findings and check how a claim is supported, with links back to the sources. Some tools search the scientific literature, others work only with documents you upload.

data.meta_desc: The best AI tools for data analysis and BI: dashboards, plain-language questions to your data, notebooks and internal apps. Which one to choose and free options.
data.intro: Data AI tools let you ask questions in plain language, build charts and dashboards, or analyze spreadsheets without writing code. Choose by where your data lives and whether you need shared dashboards for a team or a one-off analysis.

nocode.meta_desc: The best AI no-code builders for websites, web apps and mobile apps: describe your idea and get a working app. Which one to choose and which have a free plan.
nocode.intro: No-code builders turn a description or a visual editor into a working website, web app or mobile app. Prompt-first builders get you to a prototype fastest, while visual builders give more control over design, data and publishing.

education.meta_desc: The best AI tools for learning: languages, math, flashcards, tutoring and online courses. Which one fits your goal and which you can use for free.
education.intro: Learning AI adapts practice to your level, explains mistakes step by step and turns notes into flashcards or quizzes. Choose by subject and format: daily language practice, homework help or structured courses.

presentations.meta_desc: The best AI presentation makers: generate slides from a topic or document, apply a design and edit with your team. Which one to choose and which are free.
presentations.intro: AI presentation tools build a deck from a topic, outline or document and handle layout and design for you. They differ in how editable the result is, export to PowerPoint or PDF, brand templates and real-time collaboration.

business-investment.h1: Best AI tools for investing and business analysis
business-investment.meta_desc: The best AI tools for investors: charting, market data, company financials and AI-driven analysis. What each one is best at and which have a free plan.
business-investment.intro: These tools combine market data and company financials with AI features such as screeners, pattern recognition and summaries of filings. They help with research, not decisions: check the data sources and never treat a signal as financial advice.
